mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.5% consistently drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days, as ultra-low rates reduce discount rates and boost equity valuations without requiring threshold activation.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive when FEDFUNDS < 0.5% (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 5.0% triggers negative S&P 500 returns over 5 days, as rising joblessness signals economic weakness and increased risk aversion in equity markets.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are not significantly negative when UNRATE > 5.0 (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: High inflation (CPIAUCSL > 2.5%) combined with low rates (FEDFUNDS < 1.0%) causes negative S&P 500 returns over 60 days, as inflation erodes real returns without policy response.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative when CPIAUCSL > 2.5 AND FEDFUNDS < 1.0 (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS > 0.5% and rising 0.1% over 3 months) cause negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days, as rate hikes increase discount rates and reduce equity valuations.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when FEDFUNDS condition holds (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts above 1000 (HOUST) consistently drives positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days, as strong housing activity signals robust economic demand and corporate earnings growth.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive when HOUST > 1000 (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts below 1000 (HOUST) triggers negative S&P 500 returns over 5 days, as declining housing activity signals economic contraction and reduced consumer spending.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are not significantly negative when HOUST < 1000 (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production below 100 (INDPRO) combined with unemployment above 4.5% (UNRATE) causes negative S&P 500 returns over 60 days, as concurrent supply contraction and labor market weakness signal economic downturn.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative when INDPRO < 100 AND UNRATE > 4.5 (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Late-cycle expansion (HOUST > 1050 and CPIAUCSL < 2.5% YoY) drives positive S&P 500 returns over 60 days, as strong housing and stable inflation support sustained economic growth and earnings.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive when HOUST > 1050 AND CPIAUCSL < 2.5 (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.
